sources.title: Boda reports current Langfang No. 2 Phase 1 service provision
sources.summary: Operator describes Phase 1 providing computing services to leading Internet clients. July 21 supports current-operation confirmation within 90 days, not the original opening date. Campus area and potential compute capability are separately scoped; no phase IT MW is inferred.
sources.date_semantics: July 21 is a dated present-tense operator service report; conference occurred July 17–20. Not an exact opening/commissioning date.

sources.title: Boda reports Qianhai No. 1 current securities-client service
sources.summary: Operator reports a securities company recently moved into Qianhai No. 1 and describes stable ongoing client operations. August 6 is current-operation confirmation, not the exact tenant-entry or opening day. Customer is unnamed.
sources.date_semantics: The entry event is only recently; August 6 is the current service report date.

sources.title: Qi, Yu and Duan: A High-Accuracy Decryption Method of Baidu Map Coordinates, Journal of Geomatics 2022, 47(5):102–104
sources.attribution: Qi Yujie, Yu Xiaomin and Duan Zhiqiang / Journal of Geomatics
sources.summary: Peer-reviewed primary method reference, DOI 10.14188/j.2095-6045.2020498. Equation (3) defines equivalent offset iterative approximation: next estimate = current estimate + target BD09 - official_forward(current estimate). Its tests of API preimage recovery are not ground-truth accuracy evidence for these operator campus markers.
sources.date_semantics: Technical reference or calculation response, not a project status observation.
